entities.name: Precinct Four
entities.description: Turbulent district of Ravnica in the Tenth District, plagued by Gruul raids, Izzet experiments and goblin gangs.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Guild whose soldiers guard Precinct Four from Gruul raids.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Guild running volatile experiments in the precinct.

entities.name: Shattergang Brothers
entities.description: Goblin gang dealing weapons and bombs on Tin Street.

entities.name: Sunhome
entities.description: Boros Legion fortress and spiritual hub.

entities.name: Nivix
entities.description: Izzet tower and epicenter of innovation.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: Ruined northern expanse claimed by Gruul and monsters.

entities.name: Skarrg
entities.description: Gruul gathering ground around a never-ending bonfire.

entities.name: The Bulwark
entities.description: Area of housing and shops between Sunhome and Nivix.

entities.name: Mizzium Foundry
entities.description: Only place on Ravnica that makes Mizzium.

entities.name: Dargig
entities.description: Of the Shattergang Brothers; murdered by Krenko.

entities.name: Wojek League
entities.description: Law officers with an office at Tenthfort.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Guild with little jurisdiction in the Red Wastes.

events.summary: Krenko is held at Sawtooth Prison after murdering Dargig, until he stages a riot to be transferred to Udzec in Precinct Two.
events.quote: where Krenko was held prisoner after his murder of Dargig of the Shattergang Brothers
